properties.entry: Check this when you don't want to see this Fight Advisor next time. Fight Advisor could be enabled/disabled from Main Menu 'Preferences'"
The cargo hold changed and the purchase was not made. Nothing was charged.
The European price changed and the trade was not made. Nothing was charged or moved.
I't not possible to move unit here.
Do you want do destroy colony?
When you leave colony with last unit than colony will be destroyed.
Choose one passenger to land at %s.
This passenger cannot transfer now. Check the ship, destination, free cargo space and remaining movement.
Attacking %s ends peace and declares war. Fight?
The attack is no longer available. No battle was started. Check the units, positions, equipment and remaining movement, then choose the attack again.
The turn could not finish. No saved game was overwritten. Continue or load a saved game to play again.
The saved game contains invalid data and could not be loaded. The current game and save file were not changed.
The game could not be saved. Existing recovery points remain available. You can keep playing and try again.
The save folder could not be used. The current game and saved games were not changed. You can keep playing and try again.
The loser loses horses if mounted, otherwise muskets. Both units stay in place and spend their remaining movement.
%s: the unit lost its horses and survives as a soldier.
%s: the unit lost its muskets and survives unarmed.
Defeated full artillery is damaged; damaged artillery is destroyed. A defeated soldier loses horses, otherwise muskets. Both participants spend their remaining movement.
%s: artillery was damaged; attack/defense strength is now 5/3.

The defeated ship has a 50%% chance to sink; otherwise it needs repair. Without a repair destination it sinks. The victor takes goods that fit; passengers are never captured. Both ships spend their remaining movement.
%s was damaged and sent for repair to %s.
Passengers remaining aboard: %s. Goods remaining aboard: %s.
This privateer action does not declare war. Existing relations stay unchanged. Fight?
%s: a Continental or royal soldier was destroyed together with its equipment.

A defeated Continental or royal soldier is destroyed together with its equipment. An ordinary defeated soldier loses equipment as usual. The winner keeps its equipment. Both participants spend their remaining movement.
Armed defenders of %s fight first, strongest first. Winning does not capture the colony while other defenders remain. The loser loses horses if mounted, otherwise muskets.

No armed defender is left, so all colonists of %s defend together with base strength 1. Winning captures the whole colony with every worker in the fields and buildings. Losing costs the attacker its horses or muskets.

No armed defender is left, so Paul Revere arms one worker of %s from the stored muskets (%s muskets are used up). Winning still captures the whole colony. If the worker wins, it keeps the muskets and joins the garrison outside, unless it is the last resident.
%s: colony %s was captured with all its workers.

The worker of %s on this field defends alone (base strength 1 unless armed). Winning against an unarmed worker captures only that worker; the colony and its other jobs stay. The loser of an armed fight loses horses or muskets.
%s: a field worker of colony %s was captured.
%s: the armed worker keeps its muskets and joins the garrison outside the colony.
